summary.text: Andrew Parrott is the Libertarian Party nominee for Florida's 6th Congressional District and ran in the same seat's April 2025 special election. In a 2025 interview he said he worked about 20 years for one employer and had left the Republican Party for the Libertarian Party.

paragraphs.text: In a February 2025 AskFlagler interview, Parrott said he worked for roughly twenty years at a company whose health plan was self-insured and administered by Blue Cross Blue Shield. He said he joined the Libertarian Party after having been "more closely associated with the Republicans for most of my life."
WKMG ClickOrlando's 2026 voter's guide lists his age as 54.
Parrott ran as the Libertarian candidate in the April 1, 2025, special election and received 702 votes (0.4%). He is the Libertarian nominee in 2026.

sources.title: An Interview with Congressional Candidate Andrew Parrott
